reasoningChain.evidence: The boss is the remaining progression goal, but the alchemist should be tested on a known encounter first.
The prior priest lineup cleared the confluence in 17.2 seconds with all four allies alive, providing a clear comparison baseline.
The alchemist's pending experiment requires at least three skill casts in combat.
The cleared confluence is legally repeatable and avoids using an unknown support hero for the first time directly on the boss.
A clean repeat would support keeping the alchemist; a weak or unsafe result would favor restoring the proven priest before the boss.
